faq.q: Does Form 1099-S show the amount wired to me at closing?
faq.a: Do not assume that. Reported real-estate proceeds, settlement deductions and the cash delivered to you answer different questions. Compare the form with the complete closing statement and ask the issuer about an unexplained difference.

faq.q: Is the cash I receive automatically my taxable gain?
faq.a: No. The IRS explains gain using sale proceeds, selling expenses and adjusted basis. Your tax preparer needs the property history and applicable tax-year rules; the closing wire alone does not determine the answer.

faq.q: Should I ignore a form that appears incorrect?
faq.a: Keep it with your sale records, identify the particular discrepancy and contact the issuer using independently verified contact details. Ask your tax preparer how to handle it rather than changing the form yourself.

faq.q: Does choosing a cash buyer decide my home-sale tax treatment?
faq.a: No. The buyer's funding method does not establish your basis, exclusion eligibility or reporting obligations. Compare sale terms separately and obtain advice for your actual circumstances.
